test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, F, G, H, I, O, P and Q, are sitting in a row facing north. Only two people sit between I and G. Only H sits to the right of F. Only one person sits between G and F. O sits at some place to the right of P but at some place to the left of Q. Who sits third from the right end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven friends, F, G, H, I, O, P and Q, are sitting in a row facing north. 

1) Only H sits to the right of F. 

2) Only one person sits between G and F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e73e0687d22d8b4795072d4b7b1e74fd24b69af23eebbc7ade31b65ac0f001a.png] 

3) Only two people sit between I and G.

4) O sits at some place to the right of P but at some place to the left of Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ffef6e395b1f80f0e32caf0df258a4b73a74103f291440bfb10317c628ec93f.png] 

Thus, Q sits third from the right end of the line.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
